ReplicatedStorage.Config.World2BossConfi:
-- HP-only projection; never mutates the World1 table or copies its unlock rules.
local Base=require(script.Parent.World1BossConfig)
local World=require(script.Parent.World2Config)
local C={StageCount=Base.StageCount,RequiredStrengthStatus="Pending"}
local hp={}
for stage=1,C.StageCount do
 hp[stage]=assert(Base.GetMaxHP(stage))*World.World2HPScale
end
C.MaxHP=table.freeze(hp)
function C.GetMaxHP(stage) return C.MaxHP[stage] end
-- Intentionally unavailable until World2 balancing is approved.
function C.GetRequiredStrength(stage) return nil end
return table.freeze(C)
ServerScriptService.Config.World2WallCon:
-- Server-side HP-only projection from the current World1 wall authority.
local Base=require(game.ServerScriptService.World.Stage1WallManager).Config
local World=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Config.World2Config)
local C={}
for stage,entry in pairs(Base) do
 local walls={}
 for index,hp in ipairs(entry.Walls) do walls[index]=hp*World.World2HPScale end
 C[stage]=table.freeze({Walls=table.freeze(walls)})
end
function C.GetMaxHP(stage,index)
 local entry=C[stage]
 return entry and entry.Walls[index]
end
return table.freeze(C)

	[45] = 130000,
	[46] = 150000,
	[47] = 172000,
	[48] = 196000,
	[49] = 222000,
	[50] = 250000,
})

LevelRequirements.FixedStrength = FIXED_STRENGTH
LevelRequirements.MaxFixedLevel = 50

function LevelRequirements.GetRequiredStrength(level)
	level = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(level) or 1))

	local fixed = FIXED_STRENGTH[level]

	if fixed ~= nil then
		return fixed
	end

	-- Continue the existing quadratic curve, anchored at the Lv50 threshold.
	local lastLevel = LevelRequirements.MaxFixedLevel
	return FIXED_STRENGTH[lastLevel] + 10 * ((level - 1)^2 - (lastLevel - 1)^2)
end

function LevelRequirements.CalculateLevel(strength)
	local value = math.max(0, tonumber(strength) or 0)
	local level = 1

	for candidate = 2, LevelRequirements.MaxFixedLevel do
		if value < FIXED_STRENGTH[candidate] then
			return level
		end

		level = candidate
	end

	while value >= LevelRequirements.GetRequiredStrength(level + 1) do
		level += 1
	end

	return level
end

return table.freeze(LevelRequirements)
ReplicatedStorage.Modules.NumberFormat:
local M={}
local suffixes={"","K","M","B","T","Qa","Qi","Sx","Sp","Oc","No","Dc"}
function M.Format(value)
 local n=tonumber(value) or 0
 local sign=n<0 and "-" or ""; n=math.abs(n)
 local idx=1
 while n>=1000 and idx<#suffixes do n/=1000; idx+=1 end
 local text
 if n>=100 or n%1==0 then text=string.format("%.0f",n)
 else text=string.format("%.1f",n):gsub("%.0$","") end
 return sign..text..suffixes[idx]
end
-- Exact, unabridged format for existing price/reward labels.
function M.Plain(value) return tostring(value) end
return M
